response.sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders) AS order_share FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY order_share DESC, customer_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Share is computed as a floating-point (non-integer) division of the customer's order count by the total number of rows in Orders, left unrounded.

Ties at the 10th place are broken by customer_id ascending, which is an arbitrary choice permitted by the request. No NULL shares can occur since customer_id is NOT NULL and counts are always present, so the 'missing values last' requirement has no effect.
